notes.title: The "Ending Update" + Q&A
notes.content:
Hello everyone! How were your Christmas holidays? We assume they went great since many of you played a ton of [i]Ink Inside[/i]! So much so that some burning questions have come up among community members—questions we’ve taken to heart. 

Today, we’re here to address them with a new updated version of the game, tailored to meet everyone’s expectations! 

After all, you are the reason we make games, so how could we not?

Let’s dive into the [b]Q&A[/b]!

[h3]1. Can we stream [i]Ink Inside[/i]? Is there any copyright restriction or anything we should be aware of?[/h3]

There are no copyright restrictions to streaming ink inside!
Our music is all original, and yours to stream as you like!

[h3]2. Is the game finished? Is [i]Ink Inside [/i]a complete experience?[/h3]

[b]YES.[/b]
[i]However, there's been some confusion about the ending of the game...[/i]

Currently, after beating the game, there's a “teaser” cutscene of what [b]the next game in the series [/b]will look like. This teaser also plays just after the credits. (This has been changed in this version!). 

So if you happened to not understand that cutscene as a teaser, then it would feel like the game would be ending abruptly since the credits play after it.

[h3]3. Wait... Next game in the series? Will [i]Ink Inside [/i]have sequels?![/h3]

[b]YES![/b]
[i]We have a lot more story we want to tell...[/i]


In total we wrote [b]3 "seasons" of content. [/b]This is because the story of [i]Ink Inside[/i] was originally written as a [b]cartoon show for Nickelodeon[/b]! So the pacing of that story was broken into 3 seasons worth of material.

[b]INK INSIDE [/b]follows the story of [b]"season 1," which is a 9-10 hour long game,[/b] or the equivalent of about [b]24 half-hour-long episodes of a cartoon show[/b].

While we would LOVE to have all 3 seasons done immediately for launch, that would only be possible on a AAA budget for a AAA price. Instead, as a small indie team, we had to decide between prioritizing the quality of the gameplay experience, or the length of the story. So rather than making an alright game with 36 hours of great story, we made a really fun game with 10-12 hours of great story - one that we could readily make some even fun-ner sequels to. (For a $20 price, much less than AAA)!

Which also means - when we make [b]Ink Inside "Chapter 2"[/b] - it will not only have [b]more of the story we want to tell[/b] - but [b]ALSO new mechanics[/b] that you'd want from a sequel!

[h3]4. So what exactly is missing from the game?[/h3]

[b]Only a few story elements.[/b]

These are the [b]FEATURES IN THE GAME[/b]:

[list]
[*] 2 playable characters (with or without local co-op)
[*] 3 social area "towns" with NPCs and dozens of side quests
[*] 3 major "dungeon" areas with unique combat hazards (only 1 looks like an actual "dungeon" though)
[*] 15 levels of exp and stats to gain
[*] 33 unique "jobs" to find, complete, and upgrade your character with as you level
[*] 14 cores with unique combat perks that trigger on getting a "perfect hit" on an enemy
[*] 3 "secret" cores with unique-er combat perks (each granting an achievement when discovered)
[*] 20 agility items that change the way you "dodge"
[*] 21 tech items that change the way you "catch"
[*] 50+ treasure chests to find
[*] 30+ secret areas to find
[*] 8 special moves
[*] 4 "Artifacts" that add new features to the game like a "MAP" or mechanics like "Finishers"
[*] 15+ total minutes of live action cutscenes telling the story of "Hannah" the girl who drew the world and everyone in it
[*] Full VO for 12+ characters
[*] 50 Achievements
[*] Full Soundtrack with 20+ songs
[*] about 9-10 hours of narrative.
[/list]
This is the narrative [b]“STORY” IN THE GAME[/b]:

[list]
[*] The story of Princess Land + Fuzzville
[*] Where the “Sog” came from, and how it works on the doodles in the world
[*] Who Detective Fuzz is, and his backstory
[*] Who Traff is, and her backstory (concluding in their live action cutscene)
[*] Who kidnapped (dragon-napped?) Fudge
[*] Who the Ferret Doodles are and how they run their shops
[*] What Swamp Splash is, and why there's a dungeon underneath it
[*] What the Singing Skeleton is, and why it's in a dungeon
[*] Several NPC's and their stories
[/list]
This is the narrative [b]"STORY" NOT IN THE GAME[/b]:

[list]
[*] An answer to Sticks "mysterious" origins (however there's a huge spoiler to what this is  hidden in the game)
[*] An answer to who Cloak is
[*] Queen Princesses backstory
[*] The story of the next two "Notebook" locations (these are for the sequels)
[/list]

We certainly plan to address these missing story elements [b]in the sequels[/b] - but there are quite a few [b]hints [/b]about them [b]already in the game[/b] - at least enough that we've had a few streamers put parts of it together.

Overall, [b]we certainly don’t want players to feel like we’re giving them an incomplete story[/b], but we’ve also already managed to tell a story far more fleshed out than many other serialized AAA games have before us.

For example, the following games likewise end “unfinished” in their first entries:

[list]
[*] [b]Kingdom Hearts 1[/b] - Who the “Heartless” are, and why the characters were taken into the KH world is never explained.
[*] [b]Half Life 1[/b] - Science opens a portal to another Dimension. No other plot or character development is provided.
[*] [b]Assassins Creed 1 [/b]- Desmond's narrative, Ezio’s narrative, the alien language teaser, and why the Templars are hunting Assassins is never resolved.
[/list]

Ink Inside contains [b]MORE narrative exposition[/b] than you find in these games. (50,000 words worth, we've counted them!) However, much like these games, [b]INK INSIDE[/b] also has a narrative that[b] won’t be fully complete until its sequels are likewise complete.[/b] 

So! If you did not enjoy how these listed games ended “unfinished” when they were released, then it’s likely you might not enjoy Ink Inside either. 

[b]We certainly encourage you to still give INK INSIDE a try![/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3153190/Ink_Inside__First_Page/]Ink Inside: First Page[/url] is free afterall, and covers the first 2-3 hours of the game. [b]There’s a lot more to enjoy in the full game too![/b] 
Overall, we hope you finish [b]INK INSIDE[/b] excited to play a sequel, rather than not having any fun playing it at all (until the sequels are done).


[b]And... that's all for today, folks![/b]

We hope these answers clear up any doubts you might have had about [b]INK INSIDE[/b], and that the promise of sequels fills you with excitement for the future!  
The journey of Stick, Traff, and the crew has only just begun, and like them, you too are made of the stuff of heroes!

Thank you for always being with us!  

Always yours,  
[b]Blackfield Entertainment[/b] & [b]Entalto Publishing [/b]

notes.title: Ink Inside - GREAT on SteamDeck!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42948170/c26d2c8ca8a651a7b7ee3a82f4f3a8d03065adf5.gif[/img]
[h2][h1]Ink Inside was designed with the SteamDeck in mind! [/h1][/h2]

Great on controller, and just as great on SteamDeck - Ink Inside works on SteamDeck right from install, with no additional configuration required. 

Buttons are displayed as native Xbox, and controller remapping is also supported. 
There are many additional quality setting available that can also be adjusted if the game encounters any slowdown, but it hasn't been an issue in testing yet. In game icons are screen friendly and readable, with only some smaller lettering on the symbols for R3 and L3. Even the video files have been optimized for playing on the SteamDeck! (And the game is only 2GB in size!)

We think you'd enjoy the way the game feels on SteamDeck just as much as we do!

notes.title: Mark Your Calendars: Ink Inside Launches on Steam December 12th!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Ink Inside is Launching on Steam December 12th – Dive into a Hand-Drawn Adventure![/b][/h2]

Mark your calendars! [i][b]Ink Inside[/b][/i], the stunning hand-drawn beat-em-up RPG, is officially launching on Steam on [b]December 12th[/b]. Priced at [b]$19.99 USD[/b], this heartfelt adventure comes with a [b]15% launch discount for the first 14 days[/b]. Whether you’re a fan of action, storytelling, or jaw-dropping art, [i][b]Ink Inside[/b][/i] promises to deliver an unforgettable gaming experience!

[h2][b]Four Years of Passion  [/b][/h2]
Developed by the talented team at [b]Blackfield Entertainment[/b] and proudly published by us, [b]Entalto Publishing[/b], [b]Ink Inside[/b] is the result of [b]four years of dedication and hard work[/b]. From initial sketches to its vibrant, fully-realized world, the game is a testament to the team’s creativity and persistence. Every hand-drawn detail reflects their love for the craft, and the result is nothing short of magical.

[h2][b]A Collaborative Effort with the Community[/b][/h2]
This journey wouldn’t have been possible without the incredible support from you, our community. Fans worldwide have been instrumental in shaping this game, providing feedback, encouragement, and inspiration. [b]Ink Inside[/b] is as much a product of community passion as it is of developer talent, and we can’t wait for you to see the world you’ve helped create!

[h2][b]What Awaits You in Ink Inside?[/b][/h2]
Step into the shoes of [b]Stick[/b], an unfinished doodle on a mission to save their friends from the corrupting force known as the [b][i]Sog[/i][/b]. Explore a whimsical, hand-drawn world packed with creativity and personality, brought to life with a nostalgic Saturday morning cartoon aesthetic. With over [b]15 hours of original content[/b], this action-RPG offers a mix of combat, puzzles, and exploration that will keep you and your co-op buddy hooked.

- [b]Co-op Fun[/b]: Play solo or team up with a friend for local co-op, or connect online with Steam’s [b]Remote Play Together[/b].
- [b]Multilingual Launch[/b]: Fully voice-acted in English and localized in Japanese (text only), with plans to expand to more languages in the future.
- [b]Cartoon Charm[/b]: Designed by artists who previously worked on [b][i]Steven Universe: Unleash the Light[/i][/b], every frame has been lovingly crafted to evoke a sense of wonder and nostalgia.

[h2][b]Why Wait?[/b][/h2]
With its vibrant world, engaging gameplay, and heartfelt story, [i][b]Ink Inside[/b][/i] is a must-play for fans of action-RPGs and artistic indie games alike. The [b]15% launch discount[/b] is the cherry on top, making it the perfect time to experience this masterpiece.

[h2][b]Wishlist and Join the Adventure![/b][/h2]
Make sure to [b]wishlist Ink Inside on Steam[/b] today, share it with your friends and be ready to join Stick’s unforgettable journey on [b]December 12th[/b]. Together, we’ll face the Sog, rescue friends, and explore a world drawn straight from the imagination!

With love, 
Blackfield Entertainment & Entalto Publishing

notes.title: BETA UPDATE!
notes.content:
[h1]The new BETA has been completed! [/h1]

[h2]This new build includes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] 2 NEW Bosses
[*] 2 NEW enemies
[*] VO Added to some key scenes (Detective Fuzz is not yet finalized ;) )
[*] JOBS and secret new ones
[*] Hidden areas
[*] Training area mini-game for loot
[*] NEW Music
[*] Beginning of the Sugar Swamp area with related hazards
[*] Optimization and Bugfixes
[*] Enemy balancing
[*] Item balancing
[*] 5 NEW Agility Items
[*] 3 NEW upgrade stations.
[*] Added some highlights to the options menu when settings are selected.
[/list]
[b]Additionally, we THINK we may have fixed that odd inventory / UI bug that made it seem like you couldn't equip items, use the inventory, or options. [/b] This is 100% due to specific controllers acting odd when plugged in. We've done some work in hopes to fix this, but do not have a complete list of controllers that cause the issue yet. [b]IF YOU ENCOUNTER THIS BUG - PLEASE REPORT IT TO US[/b] in game through the internal report menu! If you have another controller to use, please try using that one afterwards to see if it fixes the issue!

[h2]There are still some known bugs including:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Rough VO for Detective Fuzz
[*] Several missing SFX
[*] Training Area Mini-game will have random encounters in the future, for now we've kept that off for additional optimization.
[*] Cloud Factory has some odd behavior including entering from the ceiling, and some missing geometry
[*] A couple areas have some pop-in due to recent optimizations
[*] Using a finisher on enemies that are bubbled will often cause a softlock - don't do it!
[*] Getting a perfect hit on an enemy as soon as they're hit with a box or barrel will make them stick to you.
[*] Cloud Guys sometimes run with the wrong animation
[*] AMD cards MAY have a shader bug that turns talking character darker than they should. This can usually be fixed by hitting the "PRTSC" (Print Screen) button on keyboard for some reason (we really have no idea on this one)
[/list]

Enjoy the new build and let us know what you think!

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE & LAST WEEK FOR OUR KICKSTARTER!
notes.content:
[b]Our DEMO has been updated with FINISHERS and NEW ITEMS! [/b]

Hello all! In honor of our [i]Kickstarter entering it's final week[/i], we've updated our [b]DEMO[/b]! NOW it's the same as the popular "Combat Gauntlet" that we had at PAX WEST 2023 PLUS new features and items! 

We've also done another pass at bug fixes and performance issues, with a goal for the BETA having a decent performance bump. Build notes and bugs fixed will come with the updated BETA once it's live!

This DEMO thankfully has some added band-aids to fix some of the more painful bugs that were popping up - including the UI / Options menu bug that was preventing people from using the inventory or changing their settings. 

[b]We're hoping this version of the demo addresses that issue for the most of you, but it may not fix it for everyone! [b]We're prioritizing this bug and working on a full fix for it asap![/b]
[/b]

While playing the DEMO, IF you encounter any issues, we much appreciate it if you use the internal bug reporting feature that can be found in the options menu! This sends us a bug report directly, and is incredibly helpful in diagnosing and fixing these issues!

[b]Thanks everyone for the wonderful support, and we hope you enjoy the updated DEMO! :D[/b]

notes.title: Ink Inside DEMO now available!
notes.content:
# Features
- New "Give Feedback" button in the pause menu - Please use it!
- Cores now float out of rivers and puddles!
- Lure Enemies - While resting in a combat area you've already defeated (by holding F or B), you can now call more enemies to fight!

# Tweaks
- Nicer pause menu
- Better font!
- Reduced damage done by rivers and puddles and made them easier to move through
- Double jump perks now activate on every double jump (if it's not on cooldown!)
- Sogged purple fuzzballs' water barrier budget has been cut considerably
- Big Ball special does more damage! And now destroys water barriers
- Added audio cues for ineffective attacks against armor, damaging armor, and when an enemy loses its last armor
- Players will now automatically pick up all items earned in combat after winning
- Players will now spawn at predefined "checkpoints" when loading a save file
- Environment backgrounds extended
- Big optimizations! There's still more to do, but hopefully this was a good first step. Let us know!

# Bug Fixes
- Fixed dialogue text not being positioned correctly for non-16:9 aspect ratios (characters are still slightly stretched, which is a more difficult issue to be fixed in the future)
- Fixed some graphics options not being remembered after a restart
- Fixed save slots all showing the same (wrong) info in the title screen
- Fixed Big Ball special damaging teammates
- Fixed items graphics not matching with their hitbox sometimes
- Fixed yellow spots appearing on water
- Fixed Traff's wand hand not showing in dialogue
- Fixed your character always showing the last finisher you used whenever you enter a margin
- Fixed players getting damaged when throwing a core at a crate right next to them
- Fixed an annoying invisible wall in an already difficult fight...
- Fixed enemies getting damaged by a certain sticky special attack when they shouldn't be
- Fixed damage numbers showing decimals
- Fixed core sounds not playing on perfect hits
